_note: Kit of fired parts. clay_kg = fired clay per unit (husk fill extra). method: die = constant section, pug mill + die; print = shape varies, clay printer. Masses [TO-MEASURE] on printed samples. Wall unit envelope 295 x 193 mm x depth; the 8 in unit is ~32% clay (thermal_check.py).

wall8in.universal.role: 6-row staggered cellular section, husk-filled; the bulk of every wall

wall8in.edge.role: panel edge: trapezoid section at the half-fold angle (constant along the cells -> a second die)

wall8in.rod_end.role: top/bottom of a rod column: solid bearing seat under the end channel, thick webs round the rod cell

wall8in.insert.role: face slot for a tilting insert hooked round the rod

wall4in.edge.role: panel edge: trapezoid section at the half-fold angle (constant along the cells -> a second die)

dome.eave (corbelled drip course).role: first course: seats on the steel ring, overhangs the wall face with a drip edge (the 'good hat')

dome.oculus_ring.role: compression ring round the crown opening; seat for the skylight/vent cap

wall8in.key_seat.role: edge unit with the fold-joint key seat and wedge slot (3 per panel edge)

wall4in.key_seat.role: edge unit with the fold-joint key seat and wedge slot (3 per panel edge)

dome.voussoir 8 in thermal.role: spherical dome: every course subtends the same angle, so ONE die section (wedge + seat step) serves every course; only the hoop end-cut angle changes per course (jig, leather-hard)

dome.voussoir 12 in deep dome.role: spherical dome: every course subtends the same angle, so ONE die section (wedge + seat step) serves every course; only the hoop end-cut angle changes per course (jig, leather-hard)

dome.voussoir 16 in deep dome.role: spherical dome: every course subtends the same angle, so ONE die section (wedge + seat step) serves every course; only the hoop end-cut angle changes per course (jig, leather-hard)

dome.scale_tile.role: overlapping fired scale tile, fired hotter (1,050-1,100 C) or engobed outer face; waterproofs AND weighs the crown down against wind suction

siding.board.role: hung rainscreen board 1200x200x25, double-leaf, locks into the board below (ENVELOPE.md)

plinth.fluted.role: plinth ring unit, severe-weathering grade, vertical flutes on the buried face = drainage plane

apron.fluted_paver.role: 300x200x40 paver on the crowned pad, radial flutes falling 5% outward

collector.channel.role: 300 mm channel unit, 100x75 mm flow section, 1% fall to the cistern

drain.tile.role: 300 mm fired drain tile at the bottom of the rubble trench (ASTM C4 practice)

dome.rib 16 in (skewback seats).role: rib unit, 305 mm long along the meridian; constant section with skewback seats both sides; a cell carries the rib tendon

dome.web 6 in graded.role: web unit spanning rib to rib as a shallow arch; the 6 in graded wall section; one closing key per bay-course

shelter.keystone.role: drum unit tapered wider outside; radial tongue on the leading end, radial groove on the trailing end (vertical prisms: the die makes them); inside-bottom groove + inside-top tongue wire-cut or printed; grouted cells round the rods

shelter.course_key.role: closing key of each course: no tongue, pin hole from inside; 2-4 per course so any unit is a quarter-ring from a key
